description: Labeled synonym/paraphrase retrieval set. Items are standalone memory/skill snippets; queries carry the ids of the items that should appear in the top-5. 'synonym' queries are authored to have low lexical overlap with their targets; 'exact' queries reuse target wording and must not regress.
